raw.description:
This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. 

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. 

About You

You're an engineering leader who cares about getting security-critical systems right and who wants to reach customers fast, not sit buried in a backlog. You think in specs and failure modes, you stay close to the code, and you're already using AI tooling to change how your team builds, not just how quickly they move. You'll take over a small, strong team and own how the world's most demanding manufacturers authenticate, provision, and govern access for their people and, increasingly, the AI agents acting on their behalf. 

What skills do I need?

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with direct involvement building and operating security-critical or identity/access systems in production
  • 3+ years of people management experience leading a software team, where you've hired, given constructive feedback, and grown engineers
  • Hands-on depth with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM in enterprise environments — you understand the specs and their failure modes, not just the libraries
  • Experience building multi-tenant systems where tenant isolation is a hard requirement
  • Working knowledge of IAM, secrets management, and access policy across AWS and Azure, including the tradeoffs when customers span both
  • A track record of shipping clean, tested code and holding a team to the same standard
  • Active use of AI tooling in your own practice, with a point of view on how it changes the way teams build
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent working experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for identity & access — SSO/SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM provisioning, multi-tenant account structures, and the authorization layer across Tulip's multi-cloud infrastructure.
  • Represent Identity & Access in cross-functional architecture reviews and roadmap decisions.
  • Lead and grow a small, high-caliber team — run regular 1:1s, set quality standards, give direct feedback, and develop engineers on security-critical systems.
  • Protect operations where failures carry tangible stakes—from halted production lines to scrapped material and compliance risks. What you ship here has a direct impact on customers. 
  • Drive adoption of AI tooling in how the team builds — code review, test generation, spec drafting, and agent loops — and share what works across engineering.
  • Create and own difficult tradeoffs on IAM and access policy where tenant isolation and enterprise compliance are non-negotiable.
  • Ship work that reaches customers quickly and reliably, with operational excellence as the default.

Key Collaborators

  • Security & Infrastructure  
  • Platform Engineering 
  • Product Management
  • Customer Success

Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.
 
We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

Vestiaire Collective is looking for a Senior Applied Scientist (F/M/D)

 to join the Discovery Collective team in Berlin.

About the role 

We are scaling our Discovery team to build the next-generation multistage composable search stack across query understanding, retrieval, personalized re-ranking, and recommendations. . You will be part of an unified, cross-functional squad comprising Frontend, Backend, Data Science, and Machine Learning, working in a multicultural, innovative, versatile, supportive environment that takes work-life balance seriously.  Join a cross-functional team of engineers and scientists to build Vestiaire Collective’s fashion search and recommendation engine, driving high-quality discovery across a massive catalog of 7M+ items in 80+ markets. You will work on hard and fun problems of fashion discovery where personalization matters.

What You will do 

  • Build pipelines and shared primitives for our multistage search architecture to solve use cases for fashion discovery.

  • Collaborate closely with business, product, software engineers, data scientists and machine learning engineers to drive modeling & analysis before deploying solutions to production and establish robust offline-to-online measurement frameworks. 

  • Ensure model maintenance, monitoring, and scalability are consistently addressed

  • Propose and implement R&D POC projects if you identify possible enhancements to the business, and pitch them to the relevant teams

  • You will be expected to take on a leadership role on your projects: you will make the appropriate technical choices (algorithms, data transformation, technologies to use), discuss scope & scheduling with collaborators outside the team, and incorporate feedback as needed

Who you are 

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into machine learning models, backed by exploratory data analysis and feature engineering. You are familiar with MLOps to create and optimize end-to-end pipelines.

  • Strong experience in designing, training, and delivering Machine Learning projects which have created measurable business impact on production.

  • Technical knowledge in Deep Learning, Python, SQL, Machine learning & Statistics

  • Deep expertise in core Data Science methodologies, including advanced statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, data mining, and translating raw data into actionable product insights. 

  • Preferred domain experience in Search & Recommendation systems.

  • Experience with cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), 

  • Experience with A/B testing, evaluating offline-to-online metric correlations, and iterative experimentation approach in generation.

  • Fluent English (technical interviews will be conducted in English)

  • Initiative, autonomous, communicating with technical and non technical people

Our Technology Stack includes

  • Languages: Python, Golang

  • Application Framework: PyTorch, Airflow, FastAPI, Tensorflow, Torchserve

  • Data Storage: Snowflake, Redis, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Vector Databases.

  • Others: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Github

  • More information about our stack :  Vestiaire Tech Radar and our Tech Blog

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and 28 days of paid annual leave.

  • Health and wellness support through Urban Sports Club.

  • A BVG Job Ticket for public transport in Berlin.

  • Corporate Benefits discounts of up to 40% with participating providers, including leisure activities and subscriptions.

  • A company pension scheme to help you build additional retirement savings.

  • Investment in your learning and growth, with the opportunity to shape how millions of people discover pre-loved fashion.

  • Two days to volunteer with an organisation of your choice through our Two Days to Help programme.

  • A global team representing more than 50 nationalities, working together to make fashion more circular.

 

Equal opportunities at Vestiaire Collective

Vestiaire Collective is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We value the different experiences and perspectives people bring to our teams.

Beware of recruitment scams

Vestiaire Collective only contacts candidates from official email addresses ending in ----- or from If you receive a suspicious message, please report it to We may use AI tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing CVs, assessing responses or flagging information in application materials that may need verification. These tools support our recruitment team. People make all final hiring decisions. If you’d like more information about how we process your data, please contact us.

title: Grafikdesigner:in (m/w/d) mit KI-Affinität (Studentische Hilfskraft Remote)
description: Uncoded arbeitet in München an der Schnittstelle von Media und Digital Marketing. Wir beraten Unternehmen bei ihrem Geschäftsmodell, bauen Plattformen wie den NXTGEN Club und kuratieren das Agentursegment der DMEXCO. Seit 2014 bringen unsere UNCODED Sessions außerdem die Menschen zusammen, die diese Branche prägen, in kleinen Runden, bei denen wir jeden Platz selbst vergeben. Zu unseren Partnern gehören DMEXCO, BMW, Payback und JustWatch. Unser Claim heißt Creating Momentum. Du sollst ihn sichtbar machen. Aufgaben Du gestaltest LinkedIn-Visuals, Präsentationen für Partner und Gespräche mit Entscheider:innen sowie Grafiken für unsere Events, von den UNCODED Sessions bis zum Agentursegment der DMEXCO. Du arbeitest mit unseren zwei Brandkits, Uncoded und NXTGEN Club, und entwickelst sie weiter. Vielleicht kommt bald ein drittes Brandkit dazu. Dann baust du es mit uns auf, vom ersten Moodboard bis zur Vorlage, die das ganze Team nutzt. KI gehört bei dir zum Werkzeugkasten. Du testest Tools, baust Workflows und zeigst uns, wo wir damit schneller oder besser werden, gern auch außerhalb der Grafik. Vieles ist planbar. Manches kommt am Dienstag um 16 Uhr und soll am Abend online sein. Du sagst, was dir auffällt. Wenn eine Vorlage nervt oder ein Format nicht zieht, wollen wir das hören, am besten gleich mit Vorschlag. Bringst du Kommunikationserfahrung mit, schreibst du auch Texte, planst Posts und betreust unsere Kanäle mit. Dann wächst die Stelle von 12–15 auf bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche. Qualifikation Du studierst Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Mediendesign oder etwas Vergleichbares. Dein Portfolio zeigt, wie du aus einem Satz ein Bild machst. Darauf schauen wir zuerst. Adobe Creative Cloud und Figma beherrschst du sicher. Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Midjourney, Adobe Firefly oder Runway regelmäßig und kannst ehrlich einschätzen, wann ein Bild noch Handarbeit braucht. Dir fällt auf, wenn ein Abstand zwei Pixel daneben liegt. Du arbeitest selbstständig und meldest dich, bevor jemand nachfragt. Ein Plus: Du schreibst gern, auf Deutsch und Englisch, und hast schon einen Social-Media-Kanal betreut. Benefits 12–15 Stunden pro Woche, mit Kommunikationsanteil bis zu 20, flexibel um deine Vorlesungen herum planbar Remote-Arbeit mit optional regelmäßigen Treffen im Münchner Büro Deine Arbeit landet bei Entscheider:innen aus Media und Marketing, auf der DMEXCO, auf LinkedIn und in Partnergesprächen Einblick in ein Netzwerk, das über 25 Jahre in Europas Digital- und Medienbranche gewachsen ist Echter Gestaltungsspielraum, im besten Fall bis zu einem Brandkit mit deiner Handschrift Zeit und Budget für neue KI-Tools Schick uns dein Portfolio und ein paar Sätze dazu, was dich an der Stelle reizt. Leg außerdem ein Beispiel bei, wie du KI in deiner Arbeit einsetzt, gern mit Vorher und Nachher, weil wir so am besten sehen, wie du denkst. Wenn du auch textest, freuen wir uns über zwei Textproben. Wir sind gespannt auf dich. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: IT Spezialist / IT Supporter / System Engineer • Apple, Windows, MDM • 2 Stellen • FFm *
company: Ilias Vassiliou & Team / headhunter.digital / Recruiting für Digital, Sales, IT, KI, Automation
description: Du hast Interesse & Spaß daran, Marken-Unternehmen aus dem Enterprise-Umfeld mit teils Tausenden von Apple- & Windows-Devices in heterogenen Umgebungen zu betreuen? Dann ist das hier ein Job, bei dem du dich stark weiterentwickeln kannst und vorne am Puls neuer IT-Trends bist (u.a. der Einführung von Künstlicher Intelligenz am Arbeitsplatz). Wenn du bisher hautpsächlich im Windows-Umfeld tätig warst und bereits Berührungen mit der Apple-Welt hattest, kannst du hier entsprechende Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen machen, u.a. von Apple, Jamf, Sophos (Cybersecurity), Microsoft, Veeam, Atlassian (Jira / Confluence). Apple-Devices werden im Enterprise-Umfeld meist in gemischten Umgebungen eingesetzt, so dass deine Windows-System-Erfahrung eine gute Basis für diesen Job ist. Wir suchen jemanden, der idealerweise beide System-Welten kennt, wobei die Gewichtung unterschiedlich sein kann. Wir haben hier 2 Stellen am Standort Frankfurt/M. (hybrid) zu besetzen. Über das Unternehmen dahinter ... Das Unternehmen hinter dem Job zählt zu den größten auf Apple spezialisierten B2B Systemhäusern in Deutschland und ist Teil einer internationalen IT Unternehmensgruppe mit über 8.000 Mitarbeitenden. Das vielseitige Portfolio umfasst den B2B Vertrieb von Computer Hardware (Mobil & Desktop) samt Peripherie, Consulting, Systemintegration, IT-Services. Alles hier dreht sich um Modern Workplace IT . Der Schwerpunkt liegt in der Integration von Apple/macOS- sowie Windows-Geräten in heterogenen Systemumgebungen sowie Mobil-Systemen (iOS & Android). Teils sind es viele Tausend gemanagte Arbeitsplätze bzw. Geräte über MDM/Device Management Lösungen (Jamf, Microsoft Intune etc.). Seit der Gründung vor mehr als 20 Jahren hat sich das Unternehmen zu einem Full-Service Anbieter entwickelt, der für innovative Lösungen, individuelle Kundenbetreuung und höchste Service-Qualität steht. Vom Standort Frankfurt/M. betreut das Team bundesweit namhafte Kunden aus KMU, Mittelstand sowie DAX 30 Unternehmen. Warum könnte das interessant für dich sein? Die Zugehörigkeit zu einer großen IT-Gruppe in Europa eröffnet dir attraktive Entwicklungsperspektiven. Hier kannst du mit modernsten Technologien die digitale Transformation der Kunden voranbringen - in Zukunft auch mit lokalen KI Infrastrukturen und generell mit dem Management von KI am Arbeitsplatz. Gleichzeitig kann du von Weiterbildungen profitieren und auch Zertifizierungen erwerben. Deine Aufgaben-Bandbreite ... Implementation Apple-basierter Arbeitsplatzlösungen und Device-Management-Projekte im Team 2nd/3rd-Level Support bestehender IT-Systeme, primär remote Administration von teils heterogenen Systemen mit macOS, iOS, Microsoft 365 ... Zusätzliche Spezialisierung auf (Mobile) Device Management, Storage & Backup, IT-Sicherheit Kompetenter & freundlicher Support von Kunden (u.a. bekannte Markenunternehmen) Das bringt du idealerweise mit ... Melde dich gerne, auch wenn du noch nicht 100% davon erfüllst, denn du kannst dich hier on-the-job weiterbilden. Must-have ist fundierte Kenntnis von Apple-Systemen. Dein (idealtypisches) Qualifikationsprofil ... Berufspraxis im professionellen IT-Umfeld oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Kontext (z.B. Fachinformatiker) Mind. 2 oder mehr Jahre professionelle Berufserfahrung (nach der Ausbildung) in der IT, idealerweise bei einem Systemhaus oder anderen IT Dienstleistern Kenntnisse in Support & Administration von Apple-Systemen (macOS, iOS) für Unternehmen Kenntnisse rund um Microsoft 365 (Nice-to-have) Idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Device-Management-Systemen wie z.B. Jamf, Mosyle, Intune, Meraki, Airwatch, Mobile Iron, Apple Business Manager (DEP / ADE) etc. - ansonsten bekommst du Trainings dafür Erfahrung in Support & Administration von Android- & Windows-Systemen Sicherer Umgang mit Office-Software und Ticketsystemen für IT-Support Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes und selbständiges Arbeiten Dokumentations-Disziplin, Belastbarkeit und Teamfähigkeit Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1), Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Einsätzen bei Kunden und daher Führerschein Klasse B Worauf du dich freuen kannst … Spannende größere Projekte, an denen du fachlich wachsen und mit einem Top-Team arbeiten kannst Moderne Kommunikations- und Arbeitsmittel von Apple Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für deine IT-Karriere im B2B, u.a. IT Zertifizierungen zu MDM/Jamf, Apple, Microsoft, IT-Sicherheit etc. Überwiegend Remote-Support für Kunden, on-site n Frankfurt/M. mit Home Office an 2 Tagen/Woche (nach der Probezeit und dem erfolgreichen Onboarding) Das ist eine unbefristete Direktanstellung beim Unternehmen und keine ANÜ (Arbeitnehmerüberlassung / Zeitarbeit) Ein Gehalt zw. €50k und €60k +/- p.a. je nach Erfahrung und Hintergrund Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Subventioniertes Deutschlandticket Dienstrad Zentrale Lage / sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung mit ÖPNV, nahe FFM HBf Hast du selbst konkrete Wünsche → lass uns reden! title: Senior/Staff ML Scientist - Bidding & Optimization (f/m/d)
description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world’s smartphones , connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem. Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Auctions & Real-Time Bidding The Data Science Research team builds the foundational algorithms that govern real-time bidding, budget pacing, and allocation mechanics across our products. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI—specifically reinforcement learning, objective-based optimization, and control theory—to deliver critical systems that perfectly harmonize advertiser ROI, platform health, and user relevance. These frameworks scale adjoe’s products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users . The team operates at the intersection of high-load, low-latency engineering, auction mechanism design, and state-of-the-art machine learning . Acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser, they translate complex business constraints into mathematical objectives. The stack is optimized for high throughput: PyTorch for training deep learning and RL models, distributed architectures for large-scale Bayesian inference, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain ultra-low latency, real-time production environments evaluating tens of thousands of requests per second. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics (or an MSc with extensive industry research) and a track record of peer-reviewed publications in fields like Computational Advertising, Auction Theory, Mechanism Design, or Game Theory. You’ve spent 4+ years optimizing complex systems through automated algorithms in AdTech, marketplaces, or high-frequency trading. You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting sophisticated auction mechanics, real-time bidding engines, and allocation algorithms serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users. Deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning and Optimization. You have hands-on, deep theoretical and technical expertise in objective-based optimization, control theory, or RL applied specifically to bidding, pricing strategy, and budget pacing under extreme production constraints. Mastering high-dimensional data at scale. Large-scale Bayesian inference and handling sparse, high-dimensional advertising data are core to your work. You are strongly proficient in Python and related stacks, and know exactly how to architect scalable data pipelines to feed real-time optimization models. Raises the technical bar around them. You lead architectural debates, collaborate tightly with Product Managers and Engineers to map business goals to mathematical objective functions, mentor junior scientists, and drive the team’s research direction without needing a roadmap handed to you. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum. Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams. Thrive Together. title: Product Manager, Platform (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond. The Opportunity As a Product Manager in the Platform team, you own our established booking API, used by all our clients for booking and post-sales actions. You extend its functionality to match the market, build new capabilities on top of our wealth of data, and make the API as easy as possible to use and understand, so new clients can get started faster. What you will do: Product Ownership & Strategy: Own the product end-to-end, shaping its roadmap and priorities for booking and post-sales functionality, and working autonomously within the team’s direction. API Evolution: Extend booking and post-sales capabilities to match market standards, and build new features on top of our established API. Integration Experience: Make the API simple to understand and use, with clear contracts, documentation, and flows that shorten onboarding for new customers. Complex Solution Design: Design end-to-end solutions across multiple systems and workflows, working with engineering on system design for high-load environments. Quality & Reliability: Make sure the product is robust and error-resistant, with every relevant use case and edge case covered. Data-Driven Initiatives: Use our booking data and research to find opportunities, shape strategic initiatives, and measure impact. Stakeholder Alignment: Align retailers, carriers, engineering, commercial, and operations teams around clear priorities and outcomes. Workplace: We are mainly looking for this role to be based within Germany, preferably in our HQ in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office. Who you are: 2+ years of product management experience, with a strong focus on B2B and technical products. Hands-on AI experience and the ambition to make it core to how you work, shipping faster without compromising quality. Proven experience owning API products end-to-end, from contract design to customer adoption. Solid understanding of system design and high-load, transactional systems; able to discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers. A track record of independently leading complex product initiatives with multiple stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and design thinking, especially for complex workflows and edge cases. A data-driven, impact-focused mindset, using data and research to shape decisions. Excellent communication skills in English. Nice to Have Experience with ticket-selling, booking, or auction systems. Background in travel, mobility, or marketplace platforms. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry. You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company. We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions. You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. For Management positions: As part of the management team, you will shape our strategy and organization beyond your area of responsibility. You will join an international team of talented, driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company. Our hiring process for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Anh Do and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Jorien Knipping. title: Staff Cybersecurity Specialist – Incident Response (DE)
description: About this role We are looking for a Staff Cyber Security Specialist (f/m/x) to strengthen our Incident Response and Security Operations capabilities. This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced incident responder who enjoys solving complex security challenges and helping organizations navigate critical cyber incidents. In this role, you will lead incident response engagements from investigation through recovery, working directly with customers during some of their most challenging moments . You will act as a trusted technical authority within the team, mentor less experienced responders, and help drive improvements across our security operations. Unlike traditional consultancy environments, you will operate within a product-driven MDR organization serving more than 1,000 customers across Europe . This gives you the opportunity to work at scale, leverage large security datasets, and contribute improvements that strengthen protections across our entire customer base. You will work with state-of-the-art security tooling while collaborating with security professionals from intelligence, military, consulting, national CERT, and technology backgrounds . Alongside operational response work, you'll have opportunities to contribute to internal research initiatives, Bug Bounty Fridays, Capture The Flag events, and other technical projects that help push our capabilities forward . This position reports directly to the Director of Security Operations . raw.title: Senior Product Manager (Enterprise)
raw.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to empower n8n enterprise users to treat automation as software, enabling them to develop, deploy, and scale mission-critical workflows with absolute confidence.

To do so, you’ll own product strategy and execution for n8n’s Enterprise team, focused on application lifecycle management, developer tools, and production-grade workflow operations:

WORKFLOW LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT

  • Define how teams move workflows from development to production with clear environment separation and promotion paths.

  • Shape capabilities for workflow version history, rollback, branching, and conflict resolution.

  • Build product experiences that help engineering teams safely manage changes across mission-critical automations.

ENTERPRISE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE

  • Own Git-based source control workflows that make n8n fit naturally into modern software development practices.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Design to deliver powerful yet intuitive tools for technical teams.

  • Translate complex developer workflows into product experiences that feel reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.

PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AND OBSERVABILITY

  • Build visibility into workflow performance, usage, and reliability across environments and instances.

  • Define how enterprise teams manage external secrets, variables, and configuration across deployments.

  • Help customers operate n8n at scale through multi-instance management and cross-instance visibility.

PRODUCT DISCOVERY AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

  • Deeply engage with enterprise customers, engineering leaders, admins, and developers to understand their software delivery needs.

  • Prioritize ruthlessly across technical depth, usability, enterprise readiness, and long-term platform leverage.

  • Align Engineering, Design, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership through clear strategy, specs, and communication.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped complex technical products in enterprise environments and can point to lessons learned that shaped your craft.

  • Strong developer empathy: You understand how engineering teams build, test, version, deploy, and operate software in production.

  • Thrive in ambiguity: You bring structure to fuzzy technical problems and prioritize clearly across many possible directions.

  • Exceptional product sense: You anticipate edge cases, second-order effects, and enterprise-grade reliability needs without needing perfect information.

  • Ownership and bias for action: You fix what’s broken, ship, learn, and iterate rather than over-plan.

  • Influence without authority: You align engineering, design, data, sales, solutions engineering, customer success, and docs through clarity and trust.

  • Technical product judgment: You’re comfortable making tradeoffs across usability, scalability, security, reliability, and implementation complexity.

Nice-to-haves

  • Git and source control experience: You’ve worked on or closely with products involving Git, branching, versioning, pull requests, or conflict resolution.

  • Enterprise security experience: You understand secrets management, environment variables, access control, or secure configuration patterns.

  • Observability experience: You’ve worked on products involving monitoring, usage insights, performance visibility, or operational dashboards.

  • Coding or SQL skills: You can code, write SQL, or go deep enough technically to partner effectively with engineers on architecture-level discussions.

  • Remote work experience: You’re familiar with remote-first work environments and can collaborate effectively across time zones.

  • Entrepreneurial or early-stage experience: You’ve worn many hats and can navigate in many areas at once.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll shape how engineering teams build, version, deploy, and operate mission-critical automations at scale — turning n8n into the platform where automation is treated with the same rigor as software. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first team with high autonomy, strong technical ambition, and direct visibility into enterprise customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

description: Du bist jemand, der gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Projekte von der Planung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss begleitet? In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Produktentwickler:innen stellst du sicher, dass Zeit, Budget und Qualität stets im Einklang bleiben und Risiken proaktiv gemanagt werden. Du suchst eine neue Herausforderung in einem ambitionierten Team auf dem Weg, die 360° Plattform für die Energiewende weiterzuentwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! epilot digitalisiert die Energiewirtschaft mit einer einzigartigen Cloud-Software. Wir sind ein wachsendes Scale-Up im Herzen von Köln. Unsere Mission: epilot revolutioniert die Zusammenarbeit von allen Marktpartnern, die in der Energiewelt zur Erbringung von Produkten und Dienstleistungen zusammenarbeiten. Wir bieten innerhalb der Cloudwelt ein großes Netzwerk aus Partnern, welches durch die Community ständig erweitert wird. Wir „epiloten“ sind ein Team aus Experten aus den Bereichen Softwareentwicklung, Energiewirtschaft, Produktmanagement und Sales. Um unsere Lösung noch schneller in der Energiewelt an die Spitze zu bringen, suchen wir ab sofort dich als   Senior Project Manager (m/w/d) . Das erwartet dich Erste:r Ansprechpartner:i n : Du bist der zentrale Kontakt für unsere Kunden, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und stimmst dich dazu eng mit den Produktentwicklungsteams von epilot ab. Dein Ziel ist es immer, das Projekt und den Kunden an unserer Roadmap als SaaS Company auszurichten. Projektsteuerung : Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für deine Kundenprojekte und begleitest diese bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Leuchtturmkunden : Durch die erfolgreiche Projektarbeit baust du Leuchtturmkunden auf und hilfst diese in Zusammenarbeit mit Sales und Marketing zu vermarkten. Leistungssicherung : Du stellst sicher, dass wir unsere vertraglichen Scope erfüllen und überwachst dafür Time, Budget und Quality. Risikomanagement : Du identifizierst Risiken frühzeitig und managst Eskalationen professionell. Dokumentation und Reporting : Du dokumentierst den Projektverlauf in geeigneter Form und reportest den Projektstatus, um den Fortschritt allen Stakeholdern transparent zu machen. Unterstützung und Akquisition : Bei Bedarf unterstützt du bei Angeboten und Ausschreibungen und hilfst bei der Akquirierung neuer Projekte gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb, sowie bei der Weiterentwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung im klassischen sowie agilen IT-Projektmanagement. Erfahrungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit Software-Entwicklungsteams. Idealerweise Kenntnisse / Erfahrungen in der Energiewirtschaft oder SaaS Bereich. Analytisches und strukturiertes Vorgehen sowie Überblick fürs „große Ganze“ – auch bei hoher Projektkomplexität. Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und unternehmerisches Denken an der Schnittstelle zwischen externen und internen Stakeholdern. Fähigkeit zur Risikobewertung und proaktivem Risikomanagement. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift. Start-up-Mentalität: dynamische Atmosphäre und großartiger Teamspirit. title: Intraday Power Trader (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind Impuls Energy Trading – ein junges, profitabel wachsendes Stromhandelsunternehmen mit Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien. Seit 2023 handeln wir an der EPEX Spot und sind mit der Bewirtschaftung von über 2.800 Anlagen und mehr als 3.000 MW ein relevanter Player im deutschen Energiemarkt. Kurzfristiger Stromhandel spielt eine Schlüsselrolle in einem Stromsystem, das zunehmend von erneuerbaren Energien geprägt ist. Volatile Erzeugung, Wetterdaten und Echtzeit-Dynamik machen den Markt schnell, komplex und chancenreich. Bei uns greifen datenbasierter Handel, moderne Technologie und menschliches Urteilsvermögen ineinander – getragen von einem Team, das Informationen schnell teilt und Entscheidungen gemeinsam besser macht. Für unser Trading-Team suchen wir einen manuellen Intraday Trader (m/w/d) , der den Markt live liest, Muster erkennt und auch unter Druck ruhig und klar entscheidet. Du musst nicht den klassischen energiewirtschaftlichen Weg gegangen sein. Wenn du aus dem Leistungssport, vom Pokertisch, aus kompetitivem Gaming, dem Finanzhandel oder einem anderen Umfeld kommst, in dem Fokus, Timing und gute Entscheidungen unter Druck zählen, kannst du sehr gut zu uns passen. Aufgaben Du handelst aktiv und manuell an den Spotmärkten (Day ahead und Intraday) – mit direktem Bezug zu unserem Erzeugungsportfolio und auch proprietär. Unsere Stärke ist das Handeln in volatilen Marktphasen. Du beobachtest und analysierst das Marktgeschehen live und triffst hunderte Entscheidungen am Tag, oft in Sekunden. Du erkennst Muster, interpretierst Erzeugungs-, Verbrauchs- und Wetterdaten und triffst Entscheidungen unter Zeitdruck, hochkonzentriert und mit einem Auge fürs Detail. An handelsfreien Tagen (rund ein Tag pro Woche) analysierst du Märkte, vertiefst dein Verständnis der europäischen Strommarkt-Mechanik und entwickelst und testest eigene Handelsstrategien. Du arbeitest im strukturierten Zwei-Schicht-System (Früh-/Spätschicht, keine Nachtschichten), dafür volle Präsenz zu den entscheidenden Marktzeiten. Du teilst relevante Marktbeobachtungen schnell und klar im Team, sorgst für saubere Übergaben und trägst dazu bei, dass wir als Trading-Desk gemeinsam besser werden. Qualifikation Du denkst in Wahrscheinlichkeiten und Erwartungswerten und entscheidest rational, auch wenn es schnell gehen muss. Du behältst unter Druck einen klaren Kopf : ohne Angst, ohne Gier, und ohne dich aus der Ruhe bringen zu lassen, wenn eine Entscheidung einmal gegen dich läuft. Du bringst echten, nachweisbaren Wettbewerbsgeist mit – idealerweise sichtbar in deinem Werdegang (z. B. Leistungssport, Poker, kompetitives Gaming, Wettbewerbe oder andere Felder, in denen Leistung zählt). Eine gewisse „positive Verrücktheit“ und die Fähigkeit richtig tief in eine Sache abtauchen zu können sind in diesem Markt ein entscheidender Vorteil. Du arbeitest eigenständig und verlässlich , übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ins Team ein. Du bist kompetitiv, aber nicht ego-getrieben: Du willst gewinnen, teilst Informationen offen, gibst und nimmst Feedback und stellst die Qualität des Teams über den einzelnen Trade. Analytisches Denken, Mustererkennung und ein Gespür für Details gehören zu deinen Stärken. Ein quantitatives Studium (z. B. Mathematik, Physik, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften) ist von Vorteil. The position acts as the company’s primary technical and operational authority and assumes decision-making responsibility in the absence of the Managing Director. Provide strategic oversight of the day-to-day technical operation of LNG FSRU terminals, including regasification systems, cryogenic storage, boil-off gas management and gas grid feed-in. Act as the primary technical authority for operational teams and engineering functions, providing expert guidance and escalation support on complex technical matters. Ensure consistent, high-quality performance across terminal operations, maintenance, asset integrity and engineering activities. Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analyses for critical equipment and process issues requiring senior engineering judgement. Ensure compliance with applicable European and national regulations, technical codes, classification requirements, safety standards and company policies. Represent the company at a senior technical level in dealings with authorities, engineering contractors, suppliers, classification societies and other external stakeholders. Interface with gas grid operators and regulatory stakeholders regarding the technical requirements for gas network integration. Contribute to regular reporting, both to internal and external stakeholders. The role will have at least 4 direct reports and multiple indirects. A proven track record in senior technical leadership positions such as Lead Engineer, Engineering Manager, Chief Engineer or Technical Superintendent. Expert knowledge of LNG regasification systems, cryogenic processes, boil-off gas management and associated marine and terminal systems. Extensive experience in asset integrity management, reliability engineering, maintenance strategies and HSE management frameworks. Strong knowledge of relevant European and German regulatory frameworks, technical and safety codes, classification requirements and permitting processes. Demonstrated ability to make autonomous, high-impact (technical) decisions under time pressure in safety-critical and mission-critical environments. Experience working with regulatory authorities, classification societies, engineering contractors, suppliers and gas grid operators. Strong commercial awareness and experience assessing investments, CAPEX and OPEX proposals and engineering/design modifications. Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence both senior management and operational teams. Fluent written and spoken English; German language skills would be a significant advantage. DP World hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Grenzen zu überschreiten und die Kluft zwischen allen Nationen und Kulturen zu überbrücken – nicht nur in dem, was wir tun, sondern auch in unserem Verhalten.

Wir sind bestrebt, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich jeder respektiert, unterstützt und befähigt fühlt, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Wir glauben, dass die Akzeptanz von Inklusion und Vielfalt Innovation und Wachstum vorantreibt und uns hilft, Menschen, Unternehmen und Gesellschaften zu verbinden. Freie Geister und unterschiedliche Perspektiven verändern unsere Welt, und gemeinsam können wir verändern, was möglich ist.

description: <p><strong>Are you ready to unleash your entrepreneurial spirit and be a part of an exciting start-up revolution as the main driver for its growth and success?</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About us</strong></p> <p><a href="https://setsales.com/europe/">SetSales</a> is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.</p> <p>SetSales is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity.</strong></p> <p>On the Leadership Program, you will run, grow and manage all aspects of SetSales. You will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team, ensuring the successful execution of the conference and strategy of the brand.&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll want this job if you possess strong leadership skills, excellent communication abilities, highly ambitious, forward-thinking and driven to inspire and lead a team. You are someone who is thrilled to work in a fast-paced environment and wants to scale the company rapidly.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Recruit, build and develop a high-performing team.&nbsp;</li> <li>Build an ecosystem and deliver outstanding products.</li> <li>Set clear expectations, establish goals, and provide ongoing detailed feedback and performance evaluations.</li> <li>Execute the strategy at a rapid pace.</li> <li>Develop the company’s brand as the go-to place for inspiration, knowledge and networking.&nbsp;</li> <li>Oversee planning, execution, and completion of conferences within the designated timelines and budget constraints.</li> <li>Assign tasks to team members in each department, monitor progress, and ensure project objectives are achieved.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to expand business with existing clients and collaborate with business development teams for new client acquisition.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>You’ll be working in person at our HQ in London (next to Sloane Square), constantly pushing you out of your comfort zone to ensure a never-ending growth curve for you and the business. We provide you with the following:</p> <ul> <li>The opportunity to lead, run and develop a fast-growing business, where your work and the results are highly tangible and make all the difference.&nbsp;</li> <li>Work with an incredible team with a track record of developing and growing businesses.&nbsp;</li> <li>Travel opportunity: You will be joining our conferences overseas.&nbsp;</li> <li>Competitive salary</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Requirement</strong></p> <ul> <li>+4 years’ experience from an institution with high speed and work ethic e.g. management consulting, investment banking, top-tier corporate or start-up.&nbsp;</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree with outstanding results, maybe followed by an MBA</li> <li>Strong commercial awareness and a passion for business.&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Proven track record delivering results.</li> <li>UK, EU or US work permit</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.


Your Mission

We are looking for a confirmed Backend Engineer to join the Booking team at BlaBlaCar. Their mission is to optimize our multimodal (Carpool, Bus, and Train supplies) booking and checkout experience for passengers, by integrating and unifying multiple heterogeneous inventory sources from external partners.

As confirmed Backend Engineer, your role will be to work on technical challenges and product feature developments from early-stage  conception, to development, testing strategy, deployment in production and monitoring. You will be working with a full-stack team of 10 developers. 


Your responsibilities

  • Lead the development of our new impactful features, from the early technical design to the actual rollout

  • Take part in the design definition of the services and their APIs to ensure they are scalable, robust and easy to use by Frontend developers

  • Interact with multiple business, product and engineering stakeholders from different roles, backgrounds and culture

  •  You’re definitely a team player, being eager to share and learn from your teammates and to grow altogether as a team


Your qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of experience from companies with a strong engineering culture, within a growth context

  • You are fluent in Java and know frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, JUnit, and Mockito

  • You have hands-on experience with Git, Docker, and Kubernetes, and monitoring solutions (Datadog)

  • You know what service-oriented architecture looks like, and you can determine when to apply a given architectural pattern

  • You have good communication skills, you’re humble and you're a team player

  • You are able  to take ownership, aligned with business priorities 

  • Full working proficiency in English

  • Fit with our BlaBlaPrinciples


What we have to offer

  • Hybrid status for this role - 2 to 3 days per week at the office

  • 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

  • 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

  • Financial support for home office equipment

  • Minimum 25 days holiday per year 

  • Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

  • 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

  • Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

  • Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs

  • Employee Stock ownership plan

  • Regular team building events

  • 1 day off per year to test our product


Interested in joining the ride?

  • a 45-min video-call with your Talent Acquisition Manager Chloé Friess to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

  • a 60-min video-call with Guillaume Joye, your Future Manager to discuss your experience and share more details about the team

  • a 90-min live coding session with two of our Backend Engineers

  • a 60-min video call to assess your problem-solving skills through a Design exercise with two of our Backend Engineers

  • a 30-min video-call with our Head of Engineering Louise Guibal for vision fit and rounding off the process

 

Our hiring process lasts on average 25-30 days, offers usually come within 48 hours.

Experience collaborating with Product to translate market needs, quantify revenue impact, and guide competitive positioning. Experience with integrator partners is a big plus. Native french speaker; business fluent in English Engineering or business degree with strong technical aptitude (Plus). You will define the strategy to expand our footprint exclusively within the Telecommunications sector. Complex RFP Management: Lead and coordinate responses to highly complex, multi-million-euro Telco RFPs. C-Suite Advisory: Act as the primary point of contact for C-Level as well as B-Level stakeholders in Telco organizations, identifying pain points and aligning them with Illuin’s AI roadmap. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with our Pre-sales, Products, and Engineering teams to ensure that the "vision" sold is technically sound and perfectly delivered. Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of Software/SaaS models and a genuine interest in Generative AI and Data ecosystems. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

C’est un rôle stratégique qui impactera la roadmap produit et les futurs succès de Doctrine en Espagne.
 
À noter : le poste est basé à Paris, dans nos bureaux du 18e arrondissement.
 
Tu trouveras le détail de notre stack technique sur Github !

title: Database Engineer (Stateful Services)
description: Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications. Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI and human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Database Engineer (Stateful Services) to help build and operate the infrastructure foundation behind the platform. This is a unique opportunity to work on an infrastructure environment combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads , while helping us build the reliability and operational maturity required to support 3x growth . You will report to the newly forming Stateful Services Lead and work closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure teams to improve the reliability, scalability and evolution of our stateful systems. Your mission Your goal is to build, operate and improve Diabolocom’s stateful services , with a strong focus on databases and data stores. You will help ensure that our databases and stateful systems remain highly available, reliable and performant, while evolving our infrastructure so that maintenance, upgrades and scaling can be performed safely and with minimal to no downtime. Working closely with the Stateful Services Lead, you will take ownership of specific technical projects and contribute to the evolution of our stateful infrastructure. You will: Operate and maintain our stateful services , including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ and Kafka/Redpanda. Contribute to the design, evolution and scaling of our database infrastructure, with 50+ PostgreSQL clusters and increasingly complex data workloads. Work on projects aimed at making database maintenance, upgrades and migrations safer and less disruptive to our services. Improve high availability, replication, failover, backup/restore and disaster recovery across our stateful systems. Contribute to rebuilding our PostgreSQL clusters to support automatic failover between data centers and reduce the impact of maintenance operations. Help improving our queueing infrastructure, including projects such as quorum-based RabbitMQ . Help building and maintaining stable Redis infrastructure and improve the reliability of our stateful services. Investigate and solve complex performance, scalability and reliability issues across databases and distributed systems. Work closely with development teams to understand their needs, support their use of databases and help them build reliable solutions. Collaborate with SRE, networking and infrastructure teams to ensure that our stateful services operate reliably within our broader infrastructure. Contribute to monitoring, automation and operational practices that make our infrastructure easier and safer to operate. Participate in our on-call and incident management rotation , helping diagnose and resolve production issues when needed. Stay hands-on and close to the technology: you will be expected to understand how our systems work, how they fail and how to improve them. Who we are looking for We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on Database Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and taking ownership of production systems where reliability really matters. You have experience operating databases or stateful services in production and understand that running these systems is about much more than simply maintaining them. You know how to troubleshoot them, how they behave under load, how they fail, and how to make them more reliable as they scale. You’ll work on specific technical projects defined with the Stateful Services Lead, while having the autonomy to investigate problems, propose solutions and contribute to technical decisions. We care more about your technical depth, curiosity and ability to take ownership than the exact number of years of experience you have. Must Have Strong hands-on experience as a DBA, Database Engineer, SRE or similar , with solid experience in PostgreSQL . Experience operating and maintaining production databases, including upgrades, migrations, replication, backups, recovery, monitoring and performance troubleshooting. Good understanding of high availability and reliability for stateful systems: failover, redundancy, replication, disaster recovery and minimising downtime during maintenance. Good understanding of distributed systems , including replication, consistency, fault tolerance and the challenges of operating stateful services at scale. Experience working with on-premise infrastructure or a willingness and ability to quickly adapt to an on-premise/bare-metal environment. Good system design skills and the ability to reason about scalability, reliability and performance. Experience collaborating closely with software development teams , understanding their requirements and helping them build reliable solutions around databases and stateful services. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex production issues. Strong hands-on mindset: you enjoy getting into the technical details and solving problems yourself. Comfortable participating in on-call and incident management . Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus. Nice to Have Experience with some of the following: ClickHouse or another complex database/data platform. Kafka or Redpanda and event-streaming infrastructure. RabbitMQ , particularly quorum-based configurations. Redis and distributed caching. Other database technologies such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra or MongoDB. Advanced Linux systems administration, including processes, storage, networking and troubleshooting. Bare-metal infrastructure and data-center environments. Observability and monitoring of stateful systems. Capacity planning, performance analysis and load testing. Infrastructure automation and configuration management. Incident management, root-cause analysis and post-mortem practices. About You You take ownership. When you see a reliability or scalability problem, you investigate it and work towards a solution. You are genuinely technical. You like understanding how things work under the hood and are comfortable diving deep when something breaks. You think in systems. You understand that databases don't operate in isolation and enjoy working across infrastructure, networking, SRE and development teams. You care about reliability. You want systems that can be maintained, upgraded and scaled without putting the business at risk. You are pragmatic. You can make sensible technical trade-offs in complex environments. You are curious and self-driven. You learn by doing, investigate unfamiliar technologies and are comfortable figuring things out independently. You enjoy solving complex problems. You like working on systems where there isn't always an obvious answer. You communicate clearly. You can explain technical topics and work effectively with the teams relying on your services. You are comfortable taking responsibility. You don't need to be a manager to have an impact or take the lead on a technical problem. Why join us Own critical infrastructure: your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of Diabolocom’s platform. Solve complex technical challenges: work with large-scale databases and stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis and RabbitMQ. Work on real infrastructure challenges: help improve PostgreSQL clusters, cross-data-center failover, RabbitMQ and Redis reliability. Stay hands-on: spend your time solving challenging technical problems rather than managing people. Learn and grow: work across databases, distributed systems, messaging and infrastructure in a diverse technical environment. Work across teams: collaborate closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure to build reliable systems at scale. raw.title: Database Engineer (Stateful Services)
raw.description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications.

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI and human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.
As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Database Engineer (Stateful Services) to help build and operate the infrastructure foundation behind the platform.
This is a unique opportunity to work on an infrastructure environment combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while helping us build the reliability and operational maturity required to support 3x growth.
You will report to the newly forming Stateful Services Lead and work closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure teams to improve the reliability, scalability and evolution of our stateful systems.

Your mission

Your goal is to build, operate and improve Diabolocom’s stateful services, with a strong focus on databases and data stores.
You will help ensure that our databases and stateful systems remain highly available, reliable and performant, while evolving our infrastructure so that maintenance, upgrades and scaling can be performed safely and with minimal to no downtime.
Working closely with the Stateful Services Lead, you will take ownership of specific technical projects and contribute to the evolution of our stateful infrastructure.

You will:

  • Operate and maintain our stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ and Kafka/Redpanda.
  • Contribute to the design, evolution and scaling of our database infrastructure, with 50+ PostgreSQL clusters and increasingly complex data workloads.
  • Work on projects aimed at making database maintenance, upgrades and migrations safer and less disruptive to our services.
  • Improve high availability, replication, failover, backup/restore and disaster recovery across our stateful systems.
  • Contribute to rebuilding our PostgreSQL clusters to support automatic failover between data centers and reduce the impact of maintenance operations.
  • Help improving our queueing infrastructure, including projects such as quorum-based RabbitMQ.
  • Help building and maintaining stable Redis infrastructure and improve the reliability of our stateful services.
  • Investigate and solve complex performance, scalability and reliability issues across databases and distributed systems.
  • Work closely with development teams to understand their needs, support their use of databases and help them build reliable solutions.
  • Collaborate with SRE, networking and infrastructure teams to ensure that our stateful services operate reliably within our broader infrastructure.
  • Contribute to monitoring, automation and operational practices that make our infrastructure easier and safer to operate.
  • Participate in our on-call and incident management rotation, helping diagnose and resolve production issues when needed.
  • Stay hands-on and close to the technology: you will be expected to understand how our systems work, how they fail and how to improve them.

Who we are looking for

We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on Database Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and taking ownership of production systems where reliability really matters.
You have experience operating databases or stateful services in production and understand that running these systems is about much more than simply maintaining them. You know how to troubleshoot them, how they behave under load, how they fail, and how to make them more reliable as they scale.
You’ll work on specific technical projects defined with the Stateful Services Lead, while having the autonomy to investigate problems, propose solutions and contribute to technical decisions.
We care more about your technical depth, curiosity and ability to take ownership than the exact number of years of experience you have.

Must Have

  • Strong hands-on experience as a DBA, Database Engineer, SRE or similar, with solid experience in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience operating and maintaining production databases, including upgrades, migrations, replication, backups, recovery, monitoring and performance troubleshooting.
  • Good understanding of high availability and reliability for stateful systems: failover, redundancy, replication, disaster recovery and minimising downtime during maintenance.
  • Good understanding of distributed systems, including replication, consistency, fault tolerance and the challenges of operating stateful services at scale.
  • Experience working with on-premise infrastructure or a willingness and ability to quickly adapt to an on-premise/bare-metal environment.
  • Good system design skills and the ability to reason about scalability, reliability and performance.
  • Experience collaborating closely with software development teams, understanding their requirements and helping them build reliable solutions around databases and stateful services.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex production issues.
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you enjoy getting into the technical details and solving problems yourself.
  • Comfortable participating in on-call and incident management.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.

Nice to Have

Experience with some of the following:
  • ClickHouse or another complex database/data platform.
  • Kafka or Redpanda and event-streaming infrastructure.
  • RabbitMQ, particularly quorum-based configurations.
  • Redis and distributed caching.
  • Other database technologies such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra or MongoDB.
  • Advanced Linux systems administration, including processes, storage, networking and troubleshooting.
  • Bare-metal infrastructure and data-center environments.
  • Observability and monitoring of stateful systems.
  • Capacity planning, performance analysis and load testing.
  • Infrastructure automation and configuration management.
  • Incident management, root-cause analysis and post-mortem practices.

About You

  • You take ownership. When you see a reliability or scalability problem, you investigate it and work towards a solution.
  • You are genuinely technical. You like understanding how things work under the hood and are comfortable diving deep when something breaks.
  • You think in systems. You understand that databases don't operate in isolation and enjoy working across infrastructure, networking, SRE and development teams.
  • You care about reliability. You want systems that can be maintained, upgraded and scaled without putting the business at risk.
  • You are pragmatic. You can make sensible technical trade-offs in complex environments.
  • You are curious and self-driven. You learn by doing, investigate unfamiliar technologies and are comfortable figuring things out independently.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems. You like working on systems where there isn't always an obvious answer.
  • You communicate clearly. You can explain technical topics and work effectively with the teams relying on your services.
  • You are comfortable taking responsibility. You don't need to be a manager to have an impact or take the lead on a technical problem.

Why join us

  • Own critical infrastructure: your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of Diabolocom’s platform.
  • Solve complex technical challenges: work with large-scale databases and stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis and RabbitMQ.
  • Work on real infrastructure challenges: help improve PostgreSQL clusters, cross-data-center failover, RabbitMQ and Redis reliability.
  • Stay hands-on: spend your time solving challenging technical problems rather than managing people.
  • Learn and grow: work across databases, distributed systems, messaging and infrastructure in a diverse technical environment.
  • Work across teams: collaborate closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure to build reliable systems at scale.

Recruitment Process

  1. Introductory call with Talent Acquisition (1h)
  2. Interview with Sergey, our CTO (1h)
  3. On-site System Design interview with Sergey (1h)
    Work through a technical case study and explore your system design approach.
  4. Cultural fit interview with the Team (1h)

If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p><span data-sheets-root="1">As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.</span></p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our <strong>Endpoint Protection product</strong>, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (<strong>We're currently growing multiple teams</strong> and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).</p> <p>The <strong>Platform group</strong> teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:</p> <ul> <li>Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,</li> <li>usermode security &amp; agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer &amp; interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance &amp; stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.</li> </ul> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals &amp; Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection &amp; Response eco-system.</li> <li>Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch.
