raw.title: Managing Director - France
raw.description:
Location: France

Type: Full-time | Hybrid-flexible | Based near one of our portfolio company locations

Note: This is an ongoing opportunity for future Managing Directors across the Everfield ecosystem. As we continue to grow our portfolio, we are proactively engaging with candidates who have the leadership experience and operational expertise to step into Managing Director roles within our vertical market software companies.

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices while focusing on what they do best, building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics.

Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 10 countries, and growing.

The Role

As Managing Director (MD), you will lead one of Everfield’s portfolio companies and assume full ownership of its strategy, execution, and performance. This role is designed for operationally strong leaders with deep experience in software businesses who are ready to take end-to-end responsibility for a growing company.

You will work closely with Everfield’s central teams but operate independently, with the autonomy to shape the future of the business. This role is especially suited to individuals with prior experience running software companies in a standalone or platform model, particularly in the €2M–€10M recurring revenue range.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Growth

  • Define and execute long-term strategy, aligned with scalable growth

  • Identify new market opportunities, product innovations, and partnerships

  • Monitor competitive trends to position the business effectively

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead, develop, and retain high-performing cross-functional teams

  • Inspire cultural alignment and ownership across the organization

  • Champion team effectiveness and collaboration while serving as a coach and decision-maker

Financial Acumen

  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting

  • Manage full P&L and own key performance metrics (EBITDA, ARR, MRR)

  • Drive revenue growth and cost optimization to achieve financial targets

Commercial Execution

  • Shape the go-to-market model, including sales, marketing, and pricing

  • Establish clear KPIs and performance systems to track revenue and funnel efficiency

  • Drive customer retention and recurring revenue growth

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Represent the company externally and internally with investors, partners, and customers

  • Report to Everfield’s central team with strategic and financial updates

  • Serve as the face of the business while cultivating lasting external relationships

Operational Excellence

  • Continuously improve internal operations, product delivery, and support

  • Implement systems and processes for scalable growth

  • Drive a culture of operational discipline and innovation

Candidate Profile

We are especially interested in individuals with:

  • Prior experience as a Managing Director, General Manager, or CEO in a B2B software or SaaS environment

  • Proven success leading a business with €2M–€10M in recurring revenue

  • Full accountability for business performance, including P&L, headcount, and strategy

  • Familiarity with multi-site or multi-entity software company structures

  • Experience operating within decentralised models or working with shared-service or platform support functions

  • A hands-on leadership style, grounded in operational excellence, clear communication, and cultural stewardship

  • Must be fully proficient (C1-C2) in English and French, both written and oral.

Who Should Apply

We welcome interest from experienced software leaders who understand the dynamics of buy-and-hold environments and portfolio-driven growth—particularly those who have thrived in aggregator, accumulator, or roll-up software organizations.

While we review each application carefully, we are currently focused on candidates who bring:

  • First-hand experience scaling vertical or niche software businesses

  • Familiarity with decentralized ownership and platform-based acquisition models

  • A desire to take full accountability for a business and build for the long term

If this context resonates and your experience aligns, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Lead and grow a business with full strategic and operational ownership

  • Support: Access to Everfield’s network of functional experts and peers

  • Growth: Potential to take on broader leadership within Everfield over time

  • Community: Be part of a long-term, values-driven ecosystem of software entrepreneurs

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working across key European markets with in-person collaboration

Note on Timing

While we may not have an immediate opening in your geography or vertical, we maintain a high-touch pipeline of senior candidates aligned with our investment roadmap.

Candidates with the experience outlined above will be contacted for follow-up discussions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. As the Propulsion AIT Principal Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient and technically rigorous execution of propulsion AIT activities from hardware readiness through system-level testing and delivery, provide technical direction across both teams, coordinate priorities and resources, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure that the propulsion systems meet their performance, quality, schedule and safety objectives.

This role combines technical leadership, people leadership and hands-on involvement in the preparation and execution of complex cryogenic propulsion test campaigns.

  • Provide overall technical leadership for the AIT activities of cryogenic propulsion systems

  • Define and maintain the AIT approach, philosophy, plans and technical execution strategy

  • Review and approve AIT procedures, test specifications, test plans, test reports, non-conformance dispositions and engineering change documentation

  • Lead the technical assessment and resolution of complex AIT problems, including test anomalies, hardware issues, instrumentation problems and system performance deviations

  • Oversee the preparation, integration, functional testing and acceptance activities for the propulsion systems

  • Coordinate the investigation of anomalies and ensure that root-cause analysis, corrective actions and retest activities are properly managed

  • Ensure that all AIT activities are performed in accordance with applicable safety rules, operational constraints and approved procedures

  • Lead and support the propulsion AIT Team Leaders, ensuring clear priorities, ownership and effective communication

  • Balance resources and priorities across all propulsion systems according to programme needs and test criticality

  • Support the development of the teams through coaching, technical guidance and constructive feedback

  • Build a culture of ownership, disciplined execution, continuous improvement and learning from experience

  • Contribute to integrated project planning, including AIT schedules, resource requirements, facility usage and major test milestones

  • Identify technical, operational and schedule risks related to AIT activities and ensure that mitigation actions are defined and tracked

  • Ensure compliance with company processes and applicable regulatory requirements for propulsion AIT activities

  • Promote a strong safety culture, particularly for activities involving cryogenic fluids, high pressure, hazardous energy and propulsion test operations

  • Support quality investigations, audits, non-conformance management and corrective and preventive actions

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, propulsion engineering or a related technical discipline

  • Experience with cryogenic systems, liquid propulsion, pressurised systems, fluid systems or related test operations

  • Experience planning and executing complex test campaigns from test preparation through final reporting

description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? About the Role You'll be our marketplace economics expert, using advanced analytics and causal inference to tackle our biggest strategic questions. Where will growth come from next? How does competition shape our pricing? Which incentives unlock more supply? How do inventory levels affect customer experience? Your insights will directly influence decisions across our Supply and Pricing teams, helping shape how we operate in markets around the world. What You'll Do Build causal inference models to understand the drivers of supply, pricing and assess the impact of our marketplace policies and pricing initiatives Design and analyse experiments and quasi-experiments , including holdout groups, treatment effects and cannibalisation analysis. Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations, decision tools and guardrails for Revenue, Pricing and Supply teams. Lead cross-functional projects with Supply, Pricing, Business and Engineering teams. Establish best practices for causal inference, experimentation and impact measurement , and mentor other analysts. Communicate complex analytical work clearly to senior stakeholders and influence commercial decisions. What You Bring 4-8+ years applying causal inference and statistical methods to business problems Advanced SQL & Python (and/or R) Experience driving strategic decisions through cross-functional collaboration Bonus Points Digital marketplace, e-commerce, or two-sided platform background Track record building analytics capabilities in growing organizations Experience with dbt and Tableau ** We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement listed above. We value diverse experiences and are committed to helping you grow in areas where you may have less experience. No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change. Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.   • Pitches and presentations: You build convincing pitch decks, proposals and sales materials for clients and for internal use.
  • Product demos: You present our solutions to clients and show what they actually do for them.
  • Demand generation: You help shape how we reach new clients - campaigns, events, discovery meetings - working with our team and our external partners.
  • Analysis and business cases: You put numbers behind commercial decisions and turn data into something the team can act on.
  • Internal business development: You get involved in how the company runs, improve processes and take out the manual work that eats people's time.
  • AI and automation: You use AI tools to make established processes faster, and help the rest of the team get as comfortable with them as you are.

  • Confident and proficient with Excel and PowerPoint.

board.</li> <li>A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives.</li> <li>EU Citizenship required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.  Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.    Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.    The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.   About the Job   The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines , across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.   To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment.     What you will do Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems   Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions Contribute to  simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training  Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements. Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students.   System Integration   Integrate learned components into a larger software stack Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components What we’re looking for We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply. Core qualifications 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position. Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo) Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries Proficiency in C++ Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects.  Great-to-Have Skills & Experience Experience with hydraulic machinery Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning Research experience in reinforcement learning Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units) Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms Experience with data curation for ML applications Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams.  Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools.  This Role is a Great Fit If You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world You want to help build a long-lived excavation planning and control system intended to scale and positively impact the entire construction industry.  You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements. You have a keen interest in bridging the sim2real gap and understanding the differences between simulation and physical environments.  You are excited to help drive technical direction in a growing team transitioning from prototyping to the product stage. You value a collaborative team culture rooted in thoughtful design, creative thinking, mutual respect, and pragmatism.  Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions. This is an opportunity to join a dynamic and versatile team, and to be part of a young startup that will revolutionize heavy construction.   Gravis Robotics offers a fair market salary and a working location in the vibrant city of Zurich. raw.title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
raw.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

About the Job
 
The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines, across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.
 
To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment.
 
 

What you will do
Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems
 
  • Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions
  • Contribute to  simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap
  • Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training 
  • Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements.
  • Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems
  • Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students.
    •  
    System Integration
     
  • Integrate learned components into a larger software stack
  • Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers
  • Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components

    • What we’re looking for

    We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position.

  • Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo)

  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries

  • Proficiency in C++

  • Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior

  • Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects. 

    • Great-to-Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience with hydraulic machinery

  • Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning

  • Research experience in reinforcement learning

  • Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units)

  • Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks

  • Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms

  • Experience with data curation for ML applications

  • Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams. 

  • Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools.

  • You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world

  • You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements.

title: Leader, EMEA Product Support
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow. Partner with the Incident Center of Excellence to mature the incident process (post-incident reviews, closing action items, communication playbooks, severity-based response criteria), and help build and run a sustainable off-hours coverage model, including personally rotating in as an escalation responder. Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership. Drive consistent adoption of AI tools across support workflows, piloting ways to reduce ticket-handling time, surface account context automatically, and free up analyst time for higher-value work. Collaborate with Build, Product, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and Professional Services on customer issues and incidents, keep help content and product knowledge current, and represent support at customer-facing events as needed. Work the queue alongside your team: own complex, high-priority, and escalated tickets, serve as a first-line contact for regional escalations, and model the troubleshooting, investigation, and communication standards you expect from others. QUALIFICATIONS Experienced leader who coaches with empathy and stays close to the work, with 1+ years of management experience and 5+ years of SaaS support or professional services, or demonstrated leadership, including assigning ticket work and managing queues and resources. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues. Working knowledge of support and incident tooling and best practices for technical support environments (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk, JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent), plus genuine enthusiasm for AI in support, ideally with hands-on experience piloting or driving adoption. Sound judgment under pressure: prioritizing by urgency, severity, and customer health context, and skilled in customer-facing crisis communication, including what to say, when, and to whom during a live incident, and how to translate root cause into clear RCAs/ISNs. Experience with enterprise-grade support: managing high-stakes accounts holistically, building trust with sophisticated customers, and thinking beyond individual ticket resolution. Strong communicator and customer advocate with a bias toward action, comfortable working independently across departments, remote teams, and external stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus. Based in the Zurich area, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site in our Zurich office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. HOW WE WORK We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote #BI-Hybrid #BI-Remote Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow.

  • Partner with the Incident Center of Excellence to mature the incident process (post-incident reviews, closing action items, communication playbooks, severity-based response criteria), and help build and run a sustainable off-hours coverage model, including personally rotating in as an escalation responder.

  • Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership.

  • Drive consistent adoption of AI tools across support workflows, piloting ways to reduce ticket-handling time, surface account context automatically, and free up analyst time for higher-value work.

  • Collaborate with Build, Product, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and Professional Services on customer issues and incidents, keep help content and product knowledge current, and represent support at customer-facing events as needed.

  • Work the queue alongside your team: own complex, high-priority, and escalated tickets, serve as a first-line contact for regional escalations, and model the troubleshooting, investigation, and communication standards you expect from others.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experienced leader who coaches with empathy and stays close to the work, with 1+ years of management experience and 5+ years of SaaS support or professional services, or demonstrated leadership, including assigning ticket work and managing queues and resources. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues.

  • Working knowledge of support and incident tooling and best practices for technical support environments (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk, JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent), plus genuine enthusiasm for AI in support, ideally with hands-on experience piloting or driving adoption.

  • Sound judgment under pressure: prioritizing by urgency, severity, and customer health context, and skilled in customer-facing crisis communication, including what to say, when, and to whom during a live incident, and how to translate root cause into clear RCAs/ISNs.

  • Experience with enterprise-grade support: managing high-stakes accounts holistically, building trust with sophisticated customers, and thinking beyond individual ticket resolution.

  • Strong communicator and customer advocate with a bias toward action, comfortable working independently across departments, remote teams, and external stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus.

  • Based in the Zurich area, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site in our Zurich office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

     

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

description: Ben jij een student die energie krijgt van processen doorgronden en puzzels oplossen, met interesse in privacy en data? Over MyWheels MyWheels gelooft in een toekomst waarin je mobiliteit inricht op wat je écht nodig hebt, niet op wat je bezit. Toegang tot de juiste auto, op het juiste moment. Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt. Als grootste elektrische mobiliteitsplatform van Nederland gaan we verder dan toegang tot een auto. Via Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) leveren onze elektrische auto’s ook stroom terug aan het energienet. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: <p>At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?</p> <p>As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.</p> <p>This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.</p> <p>Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.</p> <h2>What You'll Work On</h2> <p>You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:</p> <ul> <li>Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events</li> <li>Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them</li> <li>Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading</li> <li>Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise</li> <li>Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible</li> <li>Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales</li> <li>Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models</li> <li>Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper</li> <li>Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems</li> <li>Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge</li> </ul> <p>No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.</p> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <p>Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.</p> <h2>Who We're Looking For</h2> <p>We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.</p> <ul> <li>Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning</li> <li>No active backlogs</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++</li> <li>Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects</li> <li>Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking</li> <li>A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly</li> </ul> <p>Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.</p> <h2>Our Culture</h2> <p>More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.</p> <p>At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.</p> <p>Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.</p> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Join us in Revolutionizing Supply Chains
We’re a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to shape a sustainable future for the food industry. With four years of continuous 100% year-on-year growth, our team is expanding quickly. We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Recruiter to help us find the people who will drive that growth, and to help shape how we work as we scale. Join us and shape the future of food sustainability with us!

About Simvia

Ensuring responsible supply chains is one of the largest challenges of our time. At Simvia we are on a path to enable the food and consumer goods industry to become a force for good, by making it simple to prove that what we eat and use is safe, compliant, and sustainable. 

Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. AI gives us a strong tailwind: our network holds unique data, and much of the manual work in compliance can now be automated. We are growing rapidly and keep scaling with a driven, international team of 75+ people in the heart of Amsterdam. 

About this role

You will be our first in-house Recruiter. There is no recruitment playbook yet, so you build it: the process, the guardrails and the habits that let us hire fast and well as we scale. That calls for someone who thinks "I'll find a way" rather than "what's the rule here?" 

Sourcing is the heart of the job. Most of your impact comes from finding and convincing great people who were not looking. Every person you bring in shapes the company we become, so we want someone who lives our culture, not only someone who can describe it. 

Who thrives here

Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. 

Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. 

Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. 

Open. You ask for feedback and change your mind when the facts change. 

Trusting. You build real relationships and give others room to own their work. 

If this sounds more draining than energizing, that is a useful signal too. 

What you will work on

  • Sourcing and approaching great people across sales, customer success, product and engineering, through LinkedIn, referrals and cold calls, so most of our hires come from you rather than agencies 

  • Building our recruitment process from scratch: clear steps, interview templates and scorecards that every hiring manager follows 

  • Running several hiring processes at once, from role profile to signed offer, with candidates always knowing where they stand 

  • Holding hiring managers, senior leaders included, to agreed timelines and fast feedback 

  • Tracking time to hire, source effectiveness and funnel conversion, and using the numbers to improve how we hire 

  • Helping our People & Culture team with in-house events and office life in quieter hiring periods 

What you bring

  • 3+ years as a recruiter, in-house or agency, with hires across SaaS or tech roles from sales to R&D 

  • Real sourcing strength: direct approach and cold calls give you energy, and you can point to hires you found yourself 

  • A builder's mindset: you enjoy setting up processes, templates and guardrails where none exist yet 

  • Highly organized: you run many roles and steps at once without dropping anything 

  • You enjoy speed, and you are assertive with senior stakeholders while staying warm with candidates 

  • You already use AI and automation in your work and are curious about the next tool

  • Fluent English, written and spoken 

Nice to have

  • German and/or Dutch, German being the most useful 

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up 

  • Experience with an ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter 

What we offer

  • A high-paced organization with room to grow your career 

  • A meaningful mission: help the food and consumer goods industry become a force for good 

  • Training and support, a pension contribution and travel reimbursement 

  • Fresh lunch every day, monthly Thirsty Thursdays, hackathons, boat parties and our annual dance event 

  • At least three days per week in our Amsterdam city center office, with two rooftop terraces 

How we hire

An intro call with our People & Culture team, a conversation with the hiring manager, an assignment, a culture conversation and an offer. Every process includes an assignment, because we would rather see your work than hear about it. We move fast and keep you informed at every step. 

Diversity & Inclusion at Simvia

We hire people with different backgrounds, cultures, and views because it makes our work better. Whoever you are, wherever you are from, whoever you love and whatever you believe in, you are welcome here.

description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it? We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best. Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋 Meet the Backend Platform team: We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python. Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system. Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time. Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each. Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact. Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation. Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team. Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date. Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants. Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components. TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥 You'll need: Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both. Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance. Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind. Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs). Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes. Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production. A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking. Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them. Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early. Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good. It would be great if you have: Experience on a Platform or Core team. Strong production experience in both PHP and Python. Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper). Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts. Experience running incidents and blameless post-mortems. Experience with Grafana Cloud, Rollbar, or similar tools. Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, or tools for AI coding assistants. Experience mentoring engineers or leading knowledge sharing across teams. WHAT WE OFFER 🤗 We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort: 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family. 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family. 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow. 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office. 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota. 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks. 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events. 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Trading Infrastructure | Python/Linux
description: BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam. Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock. In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads. About BlockTech BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets. We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust. What will you do? You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back. You will: Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one. Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on. Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk. Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves. Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments. Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does. Change things safely. raw.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Trading Infrastructure | Python/Linux
raw.description:
BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam.

Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock.

In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust.

What will you do?

You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back.

You will:

  • Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one.

  • Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on.

  • Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk.

  • Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves.

  • Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments.

  • Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does.

  • Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark.

  • Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • 5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role.

  • At least 2 years of that in a trading environment (a trading firm, exchange, or broker), working directly with live trading systems and traders.

  • A working understanding of how trading systems operate: order and quote flow, positions and PnL, exchange connectivity, and why latency and correctness matter.

  • A commercial mindset. You can weigh technical trade-offs against business impact and explain them clearly to traders and engineers alike.

  • Strong Linux skills, including troubleshooting performance at the OS and kernel level.

  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, and multicast, plus comfort reading a packet capture.

  • Hands-on experience running production workloads in a public cloud (AWS or similar): networking (VPCs, peering, cross-region latency), compute choices, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar).

  • Proficiency in Python, and the ability to read and debug code you didn't write, including our Rust services.

  • Hands-on experience with configuration management (Ansible or similar) and CI/CD.

  • Experience operating at least some of our stack: Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Prometheus, or Grafana.

  • Calm, structured incident handling, and clear communication in English under pressure.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with options or crypto markets.

  • Exchange connectivity experience (WebSocket or FIX APIs).

  • Low-latency or market-making environments.

  • Hands-on Rust experience. Much of our platform is written in it.

  • Network hardware (Arista, Cisco), routing protocols, or packet capture tooling.

  • Server hardware and kernel tuning for low latency.

  • Running data-heavy systems such as time-series databases.

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from the first alert to the long-term fix and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Ready to keep a 24/7 trading firm running?

Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days.

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Dat geeft jou de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe ideeën uit te proberen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de manier waarop Movares zich intern en extern presenteert. Op maandag en donderdag werk je met het team in Utrecht. Op andere dagen rouleren we tussen verschillende Movares-locaties en thuis. title: Backend Software Developer
description: Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer . Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers. Jouw rol Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions). Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation). Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging. Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden. Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties . Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation . Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre . Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper). Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten. Werkplek & Sfeer : Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen. Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies. De 'Gadget Kit' : Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek. Events & Fun : Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast . Solliciteren Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 . Have a great day. Dawn Technology. We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen. title: Interim Senior Community Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.   With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.   Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.   We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other.
