raw.title: Interim Senior Community Manager
raw.description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

We’re on the search for...

Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it.

In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other.

The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp.

This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline.

The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

You’ll be:

  • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

  • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

  • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

  • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

  • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

  • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

  • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

  • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. The <strong>Customs Technology team</strong> at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.</p> <h2>The opportunity:&nbsp;</h2> <p>Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.</p> <p><strong>Things we ❤️</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way</li> <li>Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows</li> <li>Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform</li> <li>Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.</li> <li>Work on systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities and the process of moving cargo in and out of countries.</li> <li>Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.</li> <li>Geek out about shipping, customs regulations and logistics. (We do this often.)</li> <li>Figure out the most efficient way for our customers and partners to participate in the process of moving freight across borders.</li> <li>Design and build deep, complex integrations with government agencies and partners.</li> <li>Automate archaic customs filing processes and save the operations team thousands of phone calls per week.</li> <li>Deliver supply chain insights to logistics teams via a world-class analytics experience.</li> <li>Create beautiful and efficient domain models for the incredibly complex world of freight forwarding.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You should have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>≥ 5 years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.</li> <li>The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, designers and engineers alike.</li> <li>A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.</li> <li>A desire to develop your tooling repertoire. We are tech-agnostic regarding candidate background, but our platform is built with Ruby.</li> <li>Non-optional: an aptitude for learning quickly.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How we work:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>We come to the office at two to three times a week to hang out, have lunch, white board, and collaborate</li> <li>We have the latest and greatest hardware and software for you to work with</li> <li>We’re agile, but not married to a single doctrine like scrum. The teams decide how they work best.</li> <li>Stack: we’re coming from a React/Flow + Ruby on Rails monolith, and moving to React/Typescript, Kotlin Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love GraphQL, GRPC, Postgres, Kafka and Snowflake</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's in it for you?</strong></p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a&nbsp; thriving multinational environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis&nbsp;</li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover&nbsp; home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description: Ben jij ready voor Change? Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. Je werft zelf actief mee en bent daarnaast de senior op de afdeling: je coacht junior recruiters, brengt structuur aan in de dagelijkse operatie en helpt het team groeien in eigenaarschap, kwaliteit en resultaat. Daarmee maak je meteen helder: dit is geen gewone recruiterrol, maar een combinatie van zelf doen, richting geven en mensen beter maken . Hier ga je werken: Bij Change kom je terecht in een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en beweging centraal staan. We werken voor bekende merken zoals Marktplaats, Odido en Eneco en zorgen iedere dag voor de beste klantbeleving. Onze organisatie groeit hard en recruitment speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change. Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie. Je deelt kennis en helpt het team groeien in kwaliteit en eigenaarschap. Operationele aansturing Je brengt structuur aan, bewaakt de voortgang van vacatures en helpt het team prioriteiten stellen. Businesspartner voor sales en operatie Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management en HR en vertaalt personeelsbehoeften naar effectieve recruitmentacties. Candidate experience Je zorgt voor een professioneel en persoonlijk recruitmentproces waarin kandidaten zich gezien voelen. Procesverbetering en data Je optimaliseert recruitmentprocessen en gebruikt data om resultaten en effectiviteit te verbeteren. Talentpools Je bouwt aan talentpools voor commerciële en specialistische functies, zodat we ook op de lange termijn succesvol kunnen blijven werven. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat wij bij elkaar passen. Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden? Eerlijk – Je communiceert open, duidelijk en betrouwbaar.  Beweging – Je pakt aan, denkt vooruit en brengt energie in elk project.  Anders – Je ziet mogelijkheden, durft te vernieuwen en houdt het praktisch.  Expertise – Je werkt gestructureerd, deelt kennis en maakt dingen af.  Wat breng je mee? Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen recruitment, bij voorkeur in een dynamische, commerciële of snelgroeiende organisatie. Je hebt ervaring met actieve sourcing en weet hoe je latent werkzoekenden benadert en overtuigt. Je vindt het leuk om junior recruiters te coachen, te begeleiden en beter te maken in hun vak. Je hebt ambitie om leiding te geven. Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en schakelt makkelijk met teamleads, management, HR en recruiters. Je brengt structuur, overzicht en rust in een omgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt. Je hebt ervaring met interviewtechnieken, ATS-systemen en recruitmentdata. Je weet hoe je commercieel talent herkent en kunt beoordelen op salesdrive, overtuigingskracht, eigenaarschap en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en krijgt energie van targets, groei en resultaat. Je durft mensen aan te spreken op eigenaarschap, opvolging en kwaliteit. Je denkt mee over processen, maar blijft niet hangen in plannen. Jij zorgt dat dingen gebeuren. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal. Ervaring met employer branding of doelgroepgerichte arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is mooi meegenomen. Wat wij jou bieden! Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende en dynamische organisatie. Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 per maand (op fulltime basis). Een aantrekkelijke bonusstructuur op basis van prestaties en resultaten. Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Km vergoeding of NS businesscard voor jouw woon- werk verkeer. Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Een ambitieus en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. De mogelijkheid om écht impact te maken op de groei van onze commerciële organisatie. Ready for Change? Zie jij het als een uitdaging om zelf sterke commerciële kandidaten aan Change te verbinden én een recruitmentteam verder te ontwikkelen? Dan leren we je graag kennen. Solliciteer en ontdek hoe jij recruitment bij Change verder in beweging kunt brengen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
